title: Chatwoot — Free Open-Source Intercom Alternative You Self-Host
description:
Chatwoot is a free, open-source customer support platform you can run on your own server. It's a full alternative to Intercom and Zendesk, handling live chat, email, WhatsApp, and social from one inbox. Built-in help center and AI agent included. Deploy in one click.
